rule.text: He calls the baker "baker" or "friend," and talks to one baker at a time. Never "my baker," "kids" or "sweetie."

agent.problem: Too many choices require discovery or luck rather than reasoning from the earlier cards. Stop 1 card 2 gives no basis for the tribes' description of themselves, card 8 no basis for David's age, and card 10 no basis for the city; stop 2 card 2 gives no hint of the blind-and-lame taunt, card 4 no basis for Zion, card 6 no hint of the water shaft, and card 8 no basis for the extent of the building. These seven of the twelve choice cards amount to more than a few discovery questions.

rule.text: A few of those are okay, as long as most choice cards are informed guesses.
